name: Atlassian Jira Software Integration
description: Integration pack for Atlassian Jira Software, providing connectivity to Jira Cloud/Server REST APIs for issue synchronization, Agile sprint backlog planning, bug tracking, and release version mapping.

capabilities.name: Project Management
capabilities.description: Integrates Jira issue tracking, status transitions, priority updates, and team assignment sync.

capabilities.name: Backlog & Release Planning
capabilities.description: Integrates Jira Scrum/Kanban board backlogs, epic hierarchies, story points, and release fix versions.

capabilities.name: Requirements Analysis
capabilities.description: Integrates Jira User Story specifications, epic requirements, and acceptance criteria linkings.

checklists.name: Jira Integration Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Jira REST API authentication, custom field mappings, and webhook issue update listeners.

items.statement: Jira API Service Account / OAuth 2.0 token validates read/write access to target Jira project keys.
Jira Custom Fields (Story Points, Sprint ID, Acceptance Criteria) are mapped correctly.
Jira Webhooks trigger automated updates on issue created, updated, or deleted events.

reviewGates.name: Jira Integration Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Agile Delivery Lead confirms that Jira API credentials and field mappings enable bi-directional issue sync.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the Jira integration test confirm bi-directional issue synchronization and webhook delivery?
